source_role: Independent backend reviewer Decimal expression and full LP evaluator; no owner validator imported for arithmetic checks.
changes: Extracted the independent expression/full-primal routines into a standalone module.

scientific_difference: No changed objective, constraints, vectors or tolerances. These portable checks are a new packaging replay of stored results, not a new solver experiment.
